Package arcade.potts.agent.cell

Class PottsCellFlyGMC

java.lang.Object
arcade.potts.agent.cell.PottsCell
arcade.potts.agent.cell.PottsCellFlyGMC
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cell, Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
public class PottsCellFlyGMC extends PottsCell
Implementation of PottsCell for fly GMC agents. These cells divide into two PottsCellFlyNeuron cells. The links must be set in the setup file so that 100% of the daughter cells are Neurons. The basal apoptosis rate of this cell should be set to 0 in the setup file.

    • make

      public PottsCellContainer make(int newID, CellState newState, double assignedCritVol, ec.util.MersenneTwisterFast random)
      Creates a container for a new daughter cell with an explicit critical volume.

      Unlike make(int, CellState, MersenneTwisterFast), which copies this cell's critical volume, this overload lets the caller set the daughter's critical volume from the volume it is actually born into rather than inheriting the parent's.

      Parameters:
      newID - the daughter cell ID
      newState - the daughter cell state
      assignedCritVol - the critical volume assigned to the daughter cell
      random - the random number generator
      Returns:
      a container for the daughter cell
